title: handwriter texo checkpoints
description: Private: Texo (alephpi/FormulaNet, AGPL-3.0) base weights + handwriter fine-tuned checkpoints on MathWriting (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): v1 (5k subset), v2 best (epoch 2, human train) and v3 best (epoch 4, human + synthetic inks with stroke augmentation; test beam4 62.56% exact). Plus handwriter code.
